jobs.description:
Job Scope 
High level purpose of function. 

An Automation Engineer in a cell manufacturing company plays a key role in developing, optimizing, and maintaining automated production systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. They are responsible for programming, troubleshooting, and improving PLCs, robots, and other automated equipment, supporting both new production line installations and ongoing process improvements. The role also includes ensuring accurate data transfer, system connectivity, and smooth communication with cloud platforms to enable traceability, analysis, and digital integration. Close collaboration with production, engineering, and maintenance teams is required to identify and implement solutions that improve quality, throughput, and equipment uptime. A strong focus is placed on continuous improvement, safety, and scalability to meet the growing demand for electric vehicle battery production.  

Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities. 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 

Participate in HAZOP sessions and ensure compliance with process safety, operational safety, and environmental standards relating to equipment control and programming.  
Responsible for the FATs of the equipment (Project timeline dependent).  
Lead automation system integration during equipment commissioning (Project timeline dependent). 
Develop the automation systems that are to be implemented in the production and logistics equipment in the factory as well as the relevant specifications and documentation. 
Author and review engineering design documentation (Specifications, Functional design, Logic diagrams, Test Cases, Test Records).  
Train and mentor new engineers, and educate other support functions on process control.  
Code review and test of suppliers work within the projects to validate specified functionality and to ensure the quality and reliability of the data transferred from the equipment to the upper level systems. 
Participate in R&D activities for piloting of new technologies and their suitability to production environments. 
Define and improve the factory blueprint, general specifications and ways of working in collaboration with the extended automation and digitalization teams. (Project timeline dependent). 
Contribute to technical improvements, development and optimization of software processes internally in the automation team. 
The role requires regular presence on the production floor. 
Develop and maintain automation programming standards. 
Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role 

Qualifications and Experience 
Bachelors degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Electrical, Automation, Robotics, Software Engineering or similar. 
Minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience within Industrial Automation in process-driven or discrete manufacturing industries such as: Battery Cell, Automotive, Chemical, Paper, Semiconductors, Pharma, Food, Warehouses, etc. 
Experience of working with sensors, instrumentation, servo drives and motion technology. 
Experience with PLC, SCADA, OPC connectivity and MES interfaces, especially using Siemens and/or Beckhoff systems. 
Experience with industrial communication protocols and network architecture including design of control systems architecture and PLC code delivering the desired system functionality. 
Experience in writing technical documentation (Requirement specifications, Functional design, UML, Test Cases, Test Records). 
Experienced in continuous improvement and root cause analysis. 

 Specific skills & Knowledge	 
Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems. 
Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices for manufacturing systems. 
Troubleshooting skills with diagnostic equipment. 
Ability to document technical problems concisely. 
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams. 
Ability to work within varying environments including clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. 
Comfortable operating in high-profile, international, and high-pressure environments. 
A genuine technical interest and passion about working within production is highly valued.

Senior Process Engineer
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Help Industrialise the Future of Advanced Materials
Smart High Tech AB is a Swedish deep-tech company pioneering graphene-enhanced thermal interface materials for AI infrastructure, semiconductors, data centres, power electronics and high-performance computing.
As we continue our transition from product qualification and commercialisation into large-scale industrial manufacturing, we are seeking an experienced Senior Process Engineer to play a key role in developing, optimising and scaling our production processes.
This is an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled process engineer who wants to contribute to the industrialisation of next-generation graphene technology and help build a world-class manufacturing operation.
The Role
As Senior Process Engineer, you will be responsible for developing, optimising and industrialising manufacturing processes to support stable, efficient and scalable production.
Working closely with Production, R&D, Quality and Engineering teams in both Sweden and China, you will help ensure that manufacturing processes deliver the highest levels of quality, repeatability and operational performance.
The role is based in Gothenburg and requires regular travel to China to support technology transfer, process development and manufacturing scale-up activities.
Key Responsibilities

Lead the development and optimisation of manufacturing processes for mass production.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on yield, quality, efficiency and throughput.

Support the industrialisation of new products and manufacturing technologies.

Develop, evaluate and implement process improvements based on operational data and production requirements.

Optimise coating processes, carbonisation and graphitisation operations.

Establish and maintain robust process parameters, standards and control methods.

Support equipment qualification, commissioning and process validation activities.

Collaborate closely with R&D teams to transfer new technologies into production.

Work with production teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.

Support manufacturing scale-up initiatives and future capacity expansion projects.

Participate in cross-functional projects involving production, quality and engineering teams in Europe and China.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Process Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline.

Minimum 10 years' experience in process engineering within industrial manufacturing environments.

Strong experience working with manufacturing processes and production scale-up.

Hands-on experience with coating lines, thermal processing equipment, carbonisation and graphitisation furnaces.

Solid understanding of advanced materials manufacturing and process control.

Experience developing and optimising production processes for high-volume manufacturing.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Experience working in international manufacturing environments is highly desirable.

Highly Desirable Experience

Graphene manufacturing or advanced carbon materials.

Battery manufacturing and energy storage technologies.

Semiconductor or electronics manufacturing.

Advanced materials and high-tech industrial production.

Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma or continuous improvement methodologies.

Language Requirements

Fluent English, written and spoken.

Mandarin Chinese is considered a strong advantage.

Swedish is beneficial but not essential.

Personal Qualities
We are looking for someone who is:

Analytical and technically strong.

Hands-on and solution-oriented.

Structured and detail-focused.

Passionate about process optimisation and manufacturing excellence.

Comfortable working in a dynamic international environment.

Collaborative and capable of building strong relationships across functions and cultures.

Why Join Smart High Tech?
At Smart High Tech, you will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge graphene technology and contribute directly to the industrialisation of products that support the future of AI infrastructure and advanced electronics.
You will join a fast-growing international company where innovation, technical excellence and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do.
This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on the development of our manufacturing platform while working alongside leading scientists, engineers and international partners.

Help Build the Future of Advanced Manufacturing
Smart High Tech AB is a Swedish deep-tech company developing graphene-enhanced thermal interface materials for AI infrastructure, semiconductors, data centres, high-performance computing and advanced electronics.
As global demand grows, we are entering a phase of industrial expansion, manufacturing scale-up and international growth.
We are now seeking an experienced Head of PMO / Senior Project Manager to lead strategic projects and support the expansion of our manufacturing operations.
This is a unique opportunity to join a company moving from qualification and commercialisation into industrial-scale production.
The Opportunity
As Head of PMO / Senior Project Manager, you will lead key strategic and operational initiatives across the company.
Working closely with executive management, manufacturing, engineering, R&D, supply chain and international partners, you will drive complex projects from planning through execution.
A key focus will be manufacturing expansion, industrialisation and factory scale-up, including facility establishment, equipment implementation, production ramp-up and operational readiness.
The position involves frequent international travel, particularly to China, including extended stays when required.
Key ResponsibilitiesStrategic Project Leadership
Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

Establish project governance, reporting structures and best practices.

Drive timelines, budgets, resource planning and performance tracking.

Identify and mitigate project risks and operational bottlenecks.

Support executive management with prioritisation and decision-making.

Manufacturing Scale-Up & Industrialisation
Support factory establishment and manufacturing expansion initiatives.

Coordinate production readiness and operational launch activities.

Participate in facility planning, process implementation and ramp-up.

Drive industrialisation projects from pilot production to mass production.

Ensure alignment between manufacturing capabilities and business objectives.

International Operations
Coordinate projects involving teams across Europe and China.

Collaborate with suppliers, customers and strategic partners.

Build strong cross-functional relationships across international organisations.

Support operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a highly experienced project leader with a strong industrial background and a proven track record of executing complex manufacturing projects.
You have experience from factory build-ups, production ramp-ups or industrialisation programmes and understand the challenges of scaling manufacturing operations.
You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and are comfortable working with both senior leadership and operational teams.
Most importantly, you are a leader who drives execution and delivers results.
QualificationsRequired
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, Manufacturing, Operations or a related field.

Extensive experience in project management, programme management or PMO leadership.

Proven experience leading large-scale industrial or manufacturing projects.

Experience from factory build-ups or industrialisation programmes.

Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and production environments.

Experience leading cross-functional and international teams.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Fluent English, written and spoken.

Highly Meritorious
Experience from semiconductor, electronics, advanced materials, battery, automotive or deep-tech industries.

Experience from scale-up companies and high-growth environments.

Experience working with manufacturing organisations in China.

Knowledge of automation, process engineering and advanced manufacturing technologies.

PMP, Prince2 or equivalent certification.

Mandarin Chinese language skills.

Swedish language skills.

Why Join Smart High Tech?
At Smart High Tech, you will help build the manufacturing platform that supports next-generation AI infrastructure, semiconductors, and advanced electronics.
You will work alongside leading scientists, engineers and industry experts while helping transform breakthrough technology into world-class industrial production.
This is a rare opportunity to influence both strategy and execution while contributing directly to the growth of a rapidly expanding deep-tech company with global ambitions.
If you are passionate about industrialisation and manufacturing scale-up, we would love to hear from you.
Öppen för alla

Role Summary
The Outlet Manager runs day-to-day operations at Uma's Momo, a fast-casual restaurant and take-away in Gothenburg, as we prepare to open our next location. The role goes beyond running a single outlet: the successful candidate will build structured, practical ways of working that support both our current restaurant and our next location, focused on guest issue resolution, demand-based staffing, delivery-order handling, learning from incidents, quality checks and coaching, guest feedback, and training new staff. We are looking for a calm, methodical problem-solver with a strong focus on the guest experience and the ability to turn feedback and data into improvements on the floor. We have seen strong traction since opening, and being able to start immediately is a big plus.
Key Responsibilities
●     Develop and own a guest issue-resolution procedure that classifies complaints and incidents by severity (for example, an allergen reaction is critical and a wrong order is minor), sets out what staff can resolve on the spot (such as a free remake or refund) and what is escalated to the manager, and ensures every case is logged and reviewed
●     Build and manage staff rotas around expected demand, including lunch and dinner peaks, keeping labour cost on target, adjusting staffing in real time, and sharing staff between locations while the next location gets established
●     Set clear, rule-based handling for delivery and online orders, including missing items, late deliveries and refund claims, so that cases are resolved quickly and consistently
●     Go beyond completing HACCP logs: when a food-safety check fails (for example, a temperature reading), investigate the root cause and put corrective and preventive actions in place so it does not recur
●     Carry out regular service and food-quality spot checks using simple scorecards, and use the results to coach staff
●     Monitor Google and delivery-app reviews, reply to guests, and turn patterns into fixes
●     Train new staff to our service and food-safety standards ahead of the next opening
●     Interpret sales, food, labour and waste figures in our dashboards, and act on them
●     Lead daily outlet operations, including opening and closing, front-of-house service, kitchen coordination, HACCP and hygiene standards, and supplier ordering and stock control
 Required Skills and Profile
●     Master’s degree or equivalent in Business, Management, Hospitality or similar
●     Experience in operations, customer service or hospitality, including handling escalated customer complaints (international experience acceptable)
●     Fluent in English. Fluency in Nepali strongly preferred.
●     Experience in staff scheduling or demand-based workforce planning
●     Experience writing customer-issue procedures and investigating recurring problems
●     Experience training and coaching teams, including running quality checks
●     Ability to read and interpret dashboards and reports on sales, costs and performance
●     Root cause analysis or Six Sigma experience is an advantage
●     Understanding of food‑safety principles and willingness to undertake required certifications
 
Additional Information
The role combines managerial and hands-on operational work. Hours will be irregular, including evenings and weekends. A salary review will be conducted after 6 months post-probation, or upon meeting agreed performance milestones.
The employer complies fully with Swedish employment requirements, and provides the standard SAF-LO package including TFA (Work Injury Insurance), TGL (Group Life Insurance); AGS (Group Sickness Insurance); Avtalspension SAF-LO (Occupational Pension, 4.5% of salary); Premium-waiver insurance and related SAF-LO components
 The employer is committed to equality of opportunity and to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination on grounds of gender, gender identity or expression, ethnicity, religion or other belief, disability, sexual orientation or age
 To apply, please submit your CV and cover letter through the application form at umasmomo.com/join (Work with us), stating that you are applying for the Outlet Manager role, by 31st November 2026
 DO NOT email or call the restaurant phone number, this will result in automatic disqualification.

The Opportunity
Are you a driven team player early in your career, or a recent graduate with ambitions to grow through new challenges? If so, this could be the right opportunity for you.
As a SCM Specialist, you will become part of a strong team responsible for strategic sourcing within Grid Automation Products in Västerås.
You will play a key role in driving and coordinating strategic procurement activities together with suppliers of direct materials.
The role involves supplier selection, supplier development, and contributing to the continuous improvement of the procurement function through process enhancements. You will also collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Product Development, Material Planning, Manufacturing, and Operational Procurement.
During your onboarding period, you will be supported by an experienced mentor who will help you build the necessary knowledge and competencies before taking full ownership of your responsibilities.
We are looking for individuals who can complement our diverse and dynamic team. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are interested in learning more about you and what you can contribute.
How you’ll make an impact:
Managing long-term relationships with one or more key suppliers, with a focus on quality, delivery performance, and cost efficiency.
Driving activities that secure both short-term and long-term solutions related to direct material suppliers, including quality and delivery disruptions.
Participating in contract and price negotiations in both local and global environments.
Contributing to the development of the global sourcing strategy together with local and global Supply Chain organizations.
Supporting supplier selection and supplier development initiatives.
Driving continuous improvement and procurement process enhancement activities.
Working cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Product Development, Manufacturing, Material Planning, and Operational Procurement teams.

Your Background
2–3 years of professional experience from working within sourcing, with a strong desire to continue developing and take on new challenges.
Post-secondary degree, or higher, in Engineering, Business Administration, Law or Procurement / Supply Chain Management
A structured and responsible way of working, with the ability to take ownership of assigned tasks.
Strong curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset.
Enjoy working in project-based environments and collaborating with people from different functions, educational backgrounds, and cultures.
Ambition to grow professionally and take on increasing responsibility over time.
Excellent written and spoken English skills, as the role involves working in a global organization with international suppliers.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills are considered an advantage.

The opportunity
As a Senior Application Engineer for HVAC Offshore Wind, you will join a global team shaping reliable, stable, and high-quality power systems. Working closely with customers, consultants, and cross-functional teams, you will understand challenges, develop optimized solutions, and support growth aligned with our Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service (GPQSS) strategy.
You will act as a trusted technical advisor, influencing technology direction, customer engagement, and business development activities across AC Offshore Wind applications. The role also includes building competence in offshore wind configuration optimization to support future market growth.
This position is based in Västerås or Stockholm, Sweden, or Mannheim, Germany.
How you’ll make an impact
Engage early with customers to understand power systems needs, identify opportunities, and build long-term relationships with focus on technology and optimization of OSW configurations.
Support Business Development and Sales teams in developing HVAC Offshore Wind solutions tailored to customer requirements.
Develop optimized, cost-effective solutions across our Offshore Wind portfolio.
Represent Application Engineering in cross-functional teams, ensuring stakeholder alignment and successful solution integration.
Coordinate complex technical inputs, including new technologies, throughout the business development and sales cycle.

Experienced in guiding teams, coordinating complex projects, and fostering a high-performance culture,

We’re looking for a Product Owner who turns strategy into smart, scalable solutions and drives digital transformation across our global finance organization. Taking full ownership of our Finance application product, you create measurable business value, support our SAP transformation journey and lead the development and implementation of AI-enabled solutions going forward. 
With us, you get to:  
Shape how finance evolves through digitalization, automation and AI. 
 how finance works through digitalization, automation and AI. 
Join an empowered, high-trust environment that challenges established ways of working.  
Collaborate globally and contribute to the future of manufacturing.

Working in a global and agile setup, you connect business needs, technology and emerging AI capabilities while supporting our strategic capability plans and SAP transformation. 
Job responsibilities
Own and continuously develop the Finance application product across business control, finance control and related processes.  
Define and communicate the product vision, strategy and roadmap. 
Drive the development and implementation of AI-enabled solutions that strengthen finance processes and business value. 
Identify opportunities, prioritize development and guide agile teams based on business needs.

Your background also includes 
Experience leading changes and building trust across teams and functions.

Do you want to be part of shaping how a global tech company learns and develop our people? As our Learning & Development Lead, you'll drive Axis's global L&D framework, develop our learning platform and digital tools, and help keep a strong learning culture across Axis. The role is based at our headquarters in Lund. 
 

Who is your future team? 

You'll join our People Attraction and Development team in Group HR. The team has a mission to drive the development within the areas of employer branding, recruitment, social sustainability, and learning & development. Together with colleagues in Axis organizations around the world, L&D plays a central role in driving our learning culture, keeping our global programs, processes and systems running smoothly, and supporting a growth mindset. 
 

What you'll do as Learning & Development Lead 

This is an experienced individual contributor role. You'll lead and succeed in your role through your expertise, your influence, and the strong relationships you build with stakeholders around the world. 
 

You will: 

Drive, maintain and develop our global L&D framework and initiatives, working closely with L&D teams across Axis 
Own the day-to-day improvement of our learning management system (LMS), Workday Learning, drive the development of digital learning tools 
Lead L&D projects from start to finish, including the change management that helps new ways of working take hold 
Promote and facilitate our global learning initiatives, such as the Axis Mentorship program and learning on demand 
Drive initiatives that strengthen our learning culture and work with regional and local L&D teams to put Axis's learning strategy into practice. 

 
"I can offer you a role where you'll lead exciting projects, work with AI and digital tools, build relationships with many different stakeholders, and work with great professionals and lovely people. As a manager, I believe in trust-based relationships where we are partners, and my role is to support you in reaching the goals we set together." 
- Irina Belenkaya, Group People Attraction and Development Manager 
 

Who are you? 

You're curious, driven and enjoy working with both people and systems. You can connect our vision for the future of learning with technology and turn business needs into solutions that work for our teams and colleagues. You're comfortable navigating complexity and motivated by a fast-paced environment where you deliver results together with your colleagues and provide great service. You embrace feedback and are humble and self-aware. 
 

You have: 

A degree in Human Resources or equivalent 
At least 5 years' experience in a similar L&D role 
Experience managing and developing an LMS, ideally Workday Learning. 
Experience with project management and change management 
Hands-on experience using AI tools in your L&D work 
Experience with global or multicultural learning initiatives 
Strong presentation and facilitation skills 
Fluent English, written and spoken 

 
It's a plus if you speak Swedish, have experience with Confluence and Jira, and have a broader HR background. 
 

Practical details 

The role is full-time and on-site at our Lund headquarters, five days a week. It includes occasional travel. 
 

What Axis has to offer 

In addition to all the exciting things we've described above about this position and the fantastic team you'll be working with, we can offer you a workplace where we truly care about each other and our success. We are proud of the fantastic culture we create together, which is characterized by openness, collaboration, curiosity, trust and innovation. 

Ready to act? 

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. Are you an experienced QSHE professional who enjoys working closely with industrial operations? Are you motivated by taking ownership, driving improvements and making a real difference across the organisation?
We are now looking for a Sustainability Manager Nordics to join Omya in Malmö. Here, you will take on a broad and varied role, coordinating QSHE activities across the Nordic region, with a particular focus on Sweden and Finland. You will work in an international environment, collaborating with colleagues across different functions and countries.
Sounds interesting? We look forward to receiving your application!

ABOUT THE ROLE
As Sustainability Manager Nordics, you will work closely with local site managers to ensure regulatory compliance, manage operational risks and maintain high standards across Omya's production and distribution activities.
You will be part of an international matrix organisation, working with regional management, local operations and Omya's global Sustainability team.
Your main responsibilities will include:

Maintain and develop integrated management systems in accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO 50001.

Coordinate internal and external audits, certifications and corrective actions.

Monitor regulatory requirements and support compliance with relevant legislation.

Identify and assess QSHE risks and implement preventive measures together with local teams.

Follow up on performance, KPIs and targets, and provide guidance and training where needed.

The position is based at Omya's office in Malmö and involves frequent travel within the Nordic region to visit operational sites. You will report to the Head of Sustainability Nordics, based in Norway.

ABOUT YOU
We are looking for someone with a solid technical background who understands the challenges of working in a production environment and knows how to translate regulatory requirements into practical solutions.
We believe you have:

Relevant experience in QSHE, quality management, sustainability or industrial compliance.

Experience from manufacturing or industrial operations, including exposure to chemical warehousing.

Good knowledge of relevant ISO standards, management systems and regulatory requirements.

A university degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Environmental Science or a related technical field.

Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

Experience from chemical distribution, tank farms or sea shipments is considered an advantage. Finnish language skills are also a plus.
As a person, you are proactive, structured and analytical. You build trust, communicate clearly and have the confidence to challenge existing ways of working when needed. With a diplomatic and collaborative approach, you know how to engage others and drive change without formal authority.

CONTACT
In this recruitment process, Omya is partnering with Committo. For more information, please contact Linda Samuelsson at linda.samuelsson@committo.se or +46 70 216 37 52, or Ida Ingeström at ida.ingestrom@committo.se or +46 70 434 76 81 at Committo.
Interviews and selection are conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

ABOUT OMYA
Omya is a leading global producer of industrial minerals and a worldwide distributor of specialty materials. Omya was founded 140 years ago and remains a privately-owned, independent company headquartered in Switzerland but with offices and plants in more than 50 countries.
Thinking of tomorrow. Together
When you join Omya, you become part of a global team that uses its creativity, expertise and experience to make a difference to people's lives. Thinking of Tomorrow means focusing on the challenges of the future and how we can develop mineral products to solve them. This is a collaborative environment where people work towards common goals, with a common purpose.

jobs.occupation: PhD student in pavement engineering / AI based analysis
jobs.description:
VTI, the Swedish National Road and Transport Research Institute, is looking for a PhD student in pavement engineering with an emphasis on AI based automated data back-analysis method for pavement conditions and performance predictions. The position will be based in Linköping or Stockholm, Sweden
About the position
The goal of this doctoral project is to increase our knowledge and create new competencies regarding deterioration and condition development of flexible roads at the network level by utilizing artificial intelligence and large datasets. Collected data from rolling road surface testing methods (non-destructive testing) as well as climate data and registered road construction data will be analysed and used to provide reliable information about the structural condition of the pavement structure. Your assignment will be to develop methods to interpret rolling road surface testing data together with climate and pavement layer data to predict the pavement condition. The aim is to use analysis results to predict the mechanical performance of different layers in the road structure as a function of time. You will work in collaboration with the division’s professor of Road and Railway Engineering. The Swedish Transport Administration is funding the project for four years.
Your work will use information from rolling road surface measurements from Sweden and the Nordic region. Although you will devote yourself mainly to your doctoral education, you will also work to some extent with other research, field and laboratory testing, and the dissemination of research results to various actors and stakeholders.
Your qualifications
You have an MSc or equivalent in engineering or sciences, e.g. within Civil and Environmental Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or other relevant fields including computer or computational sciences.
You have an interest in data analysis and modelling, as well as laboratory and experimental work. Experience in the field of pavement/structural/geotechnical engineering, programming and in computational modelling is beneficial. The job duties require a solid foundation in the relevant theory and methodology, and you must be able to compile, analyse and present material independently.
The work will entail numerous contacts with various organisations within the transport field, cooperative partners and other researchers. You must consequently possess both good organisational and cooperative skills, as well as strong skills in written and spoken English. A good knowledge of Swedish is advantageous, but not a requirement.
We will place major emphasis on your personal characteristics, analytical abilities, and ability to take personal initiative and work independently.
Duration of employment
The position is fixed term, with increments of a maximum of one year at a time and will be reassessed on an ongoing basis each year. The position is predicated upon your acceptance into the postgraduate programme at KTH.
As a PhD student, you will be employed by VTI while simultaneously being enrolled in the doctoral programme in Civil and Architectural Engineering at the Division of Highway and Railway Engineering, KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden.
About VTI
The Swedish National Road and Transport Research Institute (VTI) is an independent and internationally prominent research institute in the transport sector with some 250 employees and an annual turnover of roughly MSEK 300. Our principal task is to conduct commissioned research and development related to infrastructure, traffic and transport. We are dedicated to the continuous development of knowledge pertaining to the transport sector, and in this way contribute actively to the attainment of the goals of Swedish transport policy.
More information
Additional information about the position is available from Research Director Björn Kalman or Professor Sigurdur Erlingsson, +46 (0)13 204123 as well docent Denis Jelagin, +46 (0)8 790 8698.
Information about how we process your personal data when you apply for a job at VTI can be found here: https://www.vti.se/en/about-vti/personal-data
We decline all offerings of advertising or recruiting assistance in connection with this recruitment.
Ref. nr: 2026/0485-3.1
The application
We welcome your application, which must include a personal letter, CV, transcripts, and any other documents you wish to cite.
The deadline for applications is 10 december

Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. Welcome to Mycronic!
About the role
Mycronic has experienced strong growth in recent years, both organically and through acquisitions. With headquarters in Sweden, Mycronic is a global organization with subsidiaries, agents, and distributors in over 50 countries. In this role, you will be part of Mycronic's PCB Assembly Solutions division (PA), a leading provider of equipment and solutions for surface mount technology (SMT). Our solutions enable electronics manufacturers to adapt production quickly while maintaining high efficiency, ranging from individual systems for specific process steps to complete production lines and advanced software for assembly process management and connected factories. 
In this role, you will be part of a multidisciplinary engineering group comprising mechanical, electronics, and mechatronics engineers. You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across different functions, including architects, service, project management, product management, production, and management. With the majority of Mycronic’s R&D operations and production facilities located on-site in Kista, you will have the opportunity to work in close proximity to both the products you develop and the people involved in bringing them to life.
Work tasks
You will take part in the entire development chain, from requirements specification to design and implementation, while working with a diverse range of materials and technologies, including welded and machined steel structures, large and small aluminum and plastic components, high-precision parts, and units for highly accurate motion control. You will work with a range of products within the PA Division, including for example Mycronic Jet Printers, MYTower systems and Pick-and-Place machines.
You will, for example:

Work with the design of mechanical components and functions.

Participate in multiple parallel projects, covering new product development, maintenance, improvements to existing solutions, and product redesign.

Participate in defining requirements and requirements reviews.

Perform verification and documentation to ensure that designs meet specified requirements.

Contribute to the development and improvement of existing ways of working and solutions by identifying opportunities for improvement and suggesting new solutions, features and accessories.

We are looking for
This role is ideal for a curious and collaborative Mechanical Design Engineer with a genuine passion for technology and engineering. You enjoy exploring new ideas, challenging existing solutions and finding better ways of working. You are eager to develop your skills, share your knowledge and learn from the experience and perspectives of others. You enjoy working hands-on with mechanical design, turning ideas into practical solutions and contributing to continuous improvements. You are a team player who values open communication, enjoys collaborating across functions and is motivated by solving technical challenges together.
Furthermore, you have:
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanics, mechatronics, or a related field. 
At least some years of professional experience in mechanical engineering, covering the entire development life cycle. 
Good knowledge in CAD, Mycronic uses SolidWorks. 
Strong proficiency in English and good knowledge of Swedish (or a willingness to learn).

Other information
Start: By agreement. 
Location: Stockholm, Kista. 
Employment: Permanent, Full-time. 
Contact information: Senior Recruitment Consultant Johanna Sörell, johanna.sorell@academicwork.se. Recruitment Coordinator Vera Mohlin, vera.mohlin@academicwork.se.
This recruitment process is managed by Academic Work. Mycronic requests that all questions regarding the position are directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase.

🚀 We are looking for: Testing Engineer – Vehicle Testing, Active Safety & Automated Vehicles
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Testing engineer
Specialization: Vehicle Inspection | Active Security | Automated Vehicles | Test & Verification
Number of posts: 1
Location: Hällered, outside Sandhult, Sweden
Start date: November 30, 2026
End date: November 29, 2027
Assignment period: 12 months
Application deadline: November 24, 2026, 00:00 CET
About the role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is seeking a dedicated Testing Engineer who wants to contribute to the development and verification of technology within active safety, automation, and the transport systems of the future.
You will work in a technical team focused on feature development and verification of active safety systems and automated vehicles. The role includes planning and conducting vehicle testing as well as analyzing and documenting test results.
You will work hands-on with both passenger cars and trucks on advanced test tracks and use specialized testing equipment, including driving robot systems and measuring instruments.
The role involves close collaboration with technical specialists, functional managers, developers, and customers. You are expected to contribute technical understanding, accuracy, and a professional approach throughout the entire testing process.
Main tasks
Plan, prepare, lead, and carry out various types of testing assignments.
Conduct vehicle testing with passenger cars and trucks on special test tracks.
Work with advanced testing equipment, including installed robotic systems and measurement equipment.
Collect, analyze, and document test results.
Report test results and ensure clear technical documentation.
Support functional managers and development teams in the ongoing work of developing and verifying products.
Contribute to the development and improvement of testing methods, test equipment, and work processes.
Maintain ongoing contact with customers and ensure a professional and service-oriented collaboration.
Represent the organization with high technical expertise and a solution-oriented approach.

Qualifications and mandatory competence
We are looking for someone with relevant technical education and experience in vehicle-related testing.
Education
Bachelor's or master's degree in mechatronics, electrical engineering, or a related technical field.
Alternatively, equivalent relevant post-secondary education.

Technical experience
Experience in vehicle-related testing and verification.
Experience with advanced measuring equipment.
Experience with ABD missile systems.
Ability to conduct technical tests, analyze results, and document conclusions.

Language and driver's license
Excellent knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written.
Swedish category B driving license.
Good driving experience.

Meritorious competence
It is an advantage if you also have:
C, CE, and/or D driving licenses.
Experience in customer-focused technical assignments.
Programming skills in Python and/or MATLAB.
Additional experience with advanced test systems, vehicle measurements, and automated test environments.

Personal qualities
We value that you are:
Analytical and meticulous with a structured approach.
Practical and comfortable working outdoors in test environments.
Independent and responsible in planning and conducting tests.
Communicative and service-oriented in contact with customers and colleagues.
Solution-oriented and interested in new technology in vehicles, safety, and automation.
A team player who enjoys collaborating in cross-functional technical teams.

Location and assignment period
Location: Hällered, outside Sandhult, Sweden
Start date: November 30, 2026
End date: November 29, 2027
The role is mainly related to practical work in vehicle and test environments. Presence on test tracks is required to carry out the testing activities.
Application
Are you a testing engineer with experience in vehicle testing, advanced measuring equipment, and automated test systems? Welcome to submit your application.
Apply here: https://www.hykmann.com/careers
Attach an updated CV clearly describing your education, experience in vehicle testing, ABD robotic systems, measuring equipment, and relevant programming skills. Also specify your availability and driver's license eligibility.

About Us
At Stellar Capacity, we empower individuals and organizations to thrive amid digital transformation. Through cutting-edge programs in leadership, AI, innovation, and change, we partner with clients globally to accelerate impact.
As we scale, we're seeking a results-driven Strategic Business Developer to fuel growth, deepen client relationships, and help us deliver transformational experiences.
In this role, you will be at the forefront of how organizations across different industries understand, explore, and work with AI. If you're excited by the idea of empowering others through education, we’d love to hear from you.
Your Role
As a Strategic Business Developer you will partner with clients to understand goals, explore options, and co-create clear program proposals. Work alongside our design, marketing, and operations teams to ensure a consistent and seamless experience from first meeting through delivery. You’ll also participate in AI programs to gather insights, strengthen relationships, and identify thoughtful next steps.
Identify new business opportunities by understanding client needs and challenges, and articulating the transformative impact AI can have on their business.
Develop and advance pipeline through targeted outreach and timely follow-up; align with marketing on campaigns and events.
Run discovery and solutioning: diagnose goals, shape recommendations, and translate needs into clear program proposals.
Own core deal stages: qualify, scope, propose, negotiate, and close mid- to large-size engagements.
Lead key relationships: serve as the day-to-day point for strategic accounts; steward executive touchpoints and stakeholder alignment.
Support “all things program + sales”: contribute to decks, one-pagers, agendas, briefs, delivery checklists, follow-ups, and case studies.
Partner cross-functionally: channel client and market insights to refine offerings, messaging, and GTM; ensure strong handoffs to delivery.
Represent the brand at webinars, workshops, and industry events- and convert interest into next steps.

What You Bring
Experienced in sales or business development (edtech, training, consulting, or services a plus) ideally from a fast-moving environment, selling technology, data or digital transformation solutions.
Exceptional relationship-building skills and natural ability to connect with people at every level, turning first conversations to long-term partnerships.
Confident with outbound outreach and meeting activity/pipeline targets.
Creative and solution-oriented mindset; you think beyond templates to design what fits the client best.
Strong presentation and storytelling skills with senior stakeholders; clear, persuasive writing.
Experienced in supporting program delivery (workshops, cohorts, trainings) and collaborating across teams.
Organized, process-driven, and comfortable with CRM, funnel metrics, and forecasting.
Genuine curiosity about AI, leadership, and learning; you like turning ideas into action.
Fluent in English and Swedish.

How You Operate
You thrive in high-velocity environments and keep standards high while moving quickly. You’re proactive, resourceful, and hungry to do your best- willing to roll up your sleeves and do what it takes to turn opportunities into impact. You stay grounded, put the mission and team ahead of ego, and measure success by shared results.
What we offer: 
Hands-On Impact: A unique opportunity to drive sales for high-impact programs that empower leaders and organizations worldwide.
Dynamic Environment: Be part of a vibrant, innovative team that values creativity, collaboration, and results.
High Candor, Low Ceremony: We give direct, respectful feedback - fast.
Career Advancement: Accelerate your career in a rapidly expanding company with opportunities for leadership and professional growth as a member of our leadership team.
Global Opportunities: Build relationships with top professionals and organizations across the globe.

Ready to make an impact?
If you want to help organizations take their next step with AI, and you thrive where relationships, strategy and results meet, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV and few lines about why this role speaks to you. We review applications continuously, so don't wait to apply.
